name: two player_dfs_salary columns on different week lists get separate aliases and separate joins
description: Two player_dfs_salary columns naming [2023_REG_WEEK_1, 2023_REG_WEEK_2] and [2023_REG_WEEK_1, 2023_REG_WEEK_3] must emit two distinct CTEs and two distinct joins. generate_table_alias hashed get_params, which collapses the week list to its FIRST entry via resolve_single_nfl_week_id, so both columns hashed identically, collapsed onto one join group, and the second rendered the first's data -- while the attach, which reads the full list, built a CTE spanning different weeks than the alias described. This is an alias-separation fixture and proves a NECESSARY condition only: two joins is what makes two different values possible, not what makes them different (see docs/create-data-view-test.md). The value half is not paired here because the attach already correlates year and week correctly -- only the alias was coarse, and a value fixture over that attach is green in both worlds.
expected_query:
with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2023]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years WHERE player.primary_position IN ('MLB')), "player_years_weeks" as (SELECT player_years.pid, nfl_year_week_timestamp.year, nfl_year_week_timestamp.week FROM player_years INNER JOIN nfl_year_week_timestamp ON player_years.year = nfl_year_week_timestamp.year WHERE nfl_year_week_timestamp.year = 2023 AND nfl_year_week_timestamp.week IN (1, 2, 3)), "t400156acfd911f6e2e96207ec19b5040" as (with "dfs_base" as (select "player_salaries"."pid", "player_salaries"."salary", "nfl_games"."season_year" as "year", "nfl_games"."week", "player_salaries"."source_id", "player_salaries"."source_contest_id", "player_salaries"."esbid" from "player_salaries" inner join "nfl_games" on "player_salaries"."esbid" = "nfl_games"."esbid" where "player_salaries"."source_id" in ('DRAFTKINGS') and "nfl_games"."nfl_week_id" in ('2023_REG_WEEK_1', '2023_REG_WEEK_2')), "dfs_ranked" as (select "dfs_base".*, dense_rank() over (partition by "source_id", "source_contest_id" order by "esbid") + dense_rank() over (partition by "source_id", "source_contest_id" order by "esbid" desc) - 1 as "slate_size" from "dfs_base") select distinct on ("dfs_ranked"."pid", "dfs_ranked"."year", "dfs_ranked"."week") "dfs_ranked"."pid", "dfs_ranked"."salary", "dfs_ranked"."year", "dfs_ranked"."week" from "dfs_ranked" order by "dfs_ranked"."pid" asc, "dfs_ranked"."year" asc, "dfs_ranked"."week" asc, "dfs_ranked"."slate_size" desc, "dfs_ranked"."source_contest_id" asc), "t8e638c89f6bf4f1f4c768c1b8f3cafdd" as (with "dfs_base" as (select "player_salaries"."pid", "player_salaries"."salary", "nfl_games"."season_year" as "year", "nfl_games"."week", "player_salaries"."source_id", "player_salaries"."source_contest_id", "player_salaries"."esbid" from "player_salaries" inner join "nfl_games" on "player_salaries"."esbid" = "nfl_games"."esbid" where "player_salaries"."source_id" in ('DRAFTKINGS') and "nfl_games"."nfl_week_id" in ('2023_REG_WEEK_1', '2023_REG_WEEK_3')), "dfs_ranked" as (select "dfs_base".*, dense_rank() over (partition by "source_id", "source_contest_id" order by "esbid") + dense_rank() over (partition by "source_id", "source_contest_id" order by "esbid" desc) - 1 as "slate_size" from "dfs_base") select distinct on ("dfs_ranked"."pid", "dfs_ranked"."year", "dfs_ranked"."week") "dfs_ranked"."pid", "dfs_ranked"."salary", "dfs_ranked"."year", "dfs_ranked"."week" from "dfs_ranked" order by "dfs_ranked"."pid" asc, "dfs_ranked"."year" asc, "dfs_ranked"."week" asc, "dfs_ranked"."slate_size" desc, "dfs_ranked"."source_contest_id" asc), "player_participation_weeks" as (SELECT pid, year, week, bool_or(is_active) AS is_active
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2023::int AS year, g.week, pgl.is_active
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2023 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2023) src
          GROUP BY pid, year, week), "player_years_teams" as (SELECT pid, year, array_agg(DISTINCT team_code) AS teams
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2023::int AS year, pgl.nfl_team AS team_code
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2023 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2023) src
          GROUP BY pid, year), "team_weeks_played" as (select distinct "team", "year", "week" from ((select "home_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."week" in (1, 2, 3) and "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023)) union all (select "away_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."week" in (1, 2, 3) and "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023))) as "g") select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "t400156acfd911f6e2e96207ec19b5040"."salary" AS "dfs_salary_0", "t8e638c89f6bf4f1f4c768c1b8f3cafdd"."salary" AS "dfs_salary_1", "player_years_weeks"."year", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END AS participation_status, "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years_weeks" on "player_years_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "t400156acfd911f6e2e96207ec19b5040" on "t400156acfd911f6e2e96207ec19b5040"."pid" = "player"."pid" and t400156acfd911f6e2e96207ec19b5040.year = player_years_weeks.year and t400156acfd911f6e2e96207ec19b5040.week = player_years_weeks.week left join "t8e638c89f6bf4f1f4c768c1b8f3cafdd" on "t8e638c89f6bf4f1f4c768c1b8f3cafdd"."pid" = "player"."pid" and t8e638c89f6bf4f1f4c768c1b8f3cafdd.year = player_years_weeks.year and t8e638c89f6bf4f1f4c768c1b8f3cafdd.week = player_years_weeks.week left join "player_participation_weeks" on "player_participation_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_participation_weeks"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" and "player_participation_weeks"."week" = "player_years_weeks"."week" left join "player_years_teams" on "player_years_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_years_teams"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" where player.primary_position IN ('MLB') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "t400156acfd911f6e2e96207ec19b5040"."salary", "t8e638c89f6bf4f1f4c768c1b8f3cafdd"."salary", "player_years_weeks"."year", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
